classification: Local author proof and implementation review; no independent agent or human review

Original optimized coefficient balls are used; NS89 normalized rational trials are not substituted.
Old normal equations remove old coefficients exactly; prime main terms cancel.

The 0<t<1 contribution to I_T and direct pairing is included.

Cutoff-dependent individual summands are not asserted invariant across cutoffs.

No new finite gain efficiency, cofinal decay theorem, independent review, or manuscript version is claimed.

obstruction: Termwise absolute estimates lose internal finite arithmetic cancellation and are vacuous in the certified tests.
bound_or_object: Failure of the tested bound, not failure of the signed direction or full PR42 route.
